messages:
Sara: quick proposal: move low-latency routes to a per-route EWMA sampler + a console 'inspect' grant. global sampler spikes during bursts and skews quota math. asking ops, legal, and devex for input.

Mike: how invasive is this at runtime? any extra RPCs?

Sara: very small. decisions remain local; controller keeps EWMA of qps and token-rate, window 60s, alpha 0.3. floor 0.1%, cap 20%. we emit route.sample_rate for billing.

Alex: console needs safety: per-route inspect button that issues a short-lived token (ttl 10m), writes an audit entry, and shows requester. default off; manual slider only behind dev flag.

Tara: product: default adaptive on for prod tenants? worried about surprise captures.

Jessica: legal: require audit logs, ephemeral retention for full payloads (max 30d), HMAC pseudonymization for user ids, and org-admin opt-in for inspect on private installs.

Sara: sample feature flag config we'll ship: {"route":"/v1/generate","sampling":{"mode":"ewma","alpha":"0.3","floor_pct":"0.001","cap_pct":"0.2","budget_tokens_per_min":"250000"},"inspect":{"enabled":"true","ttl_seconds":"600","audit_log":"true"}}

Mike: ops notes: add fallback to static sampler if controller fails; emit incident metric. enforce rpm hard-cap to protect storage if cap is mis-set.

Alex: UI telemetry to show: 24h effective sample rate, inspect grants count, last grant owner, and override actor.

Tara: rollout plan: 1) flag internal/system routes only, 2) console read-only metrics for a week, 3) opt-in for teams to enable inspect, 4) customer rollout after legal + small canary.

Jessica: I can sign off after HMAC hooks and retention policy are in the PR. add pseudonymization lib and docs.

Sara: I'll open RFC + PR with e2e test and HMAC plugin link.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 2025-09-01T03:00Z -> 10% routes with flag `ewma-sampler`.

Mike: I'll monitor route.sample_rate dash and alert on token spend/5xx spikes. :thumbsup:

Alex: mockups later today.

Tara: adding to rollout checklist.

Sara: thanks, follow-ups in the RFC thread.
